paragraphs.source_en: I stand on the bridge. This mellow, ripened dusk— from afar come the music of flute and zither, dots and threads, round, square, elongated, everywhere pure, blazing gold, pouring down among the ripples, clear blue and evenly still. Voices, a boat, and the flicker of lamps, light and candle glow, a dreamlike waking, —drowsy haze— phantasmal visions seem to fade away before the breast of the running water— fresh and tender, softly intertwined— flow, flow, flowing into the deep, heavy dusk. The zither of my soul, feeling an invisible impulse, startled, then suddenly wakeful, it hums softly in quiet murmur, a new song, as fresh as a red-blossom wax candle, with a rich fragrance rising from the throat. But this subtle zither of the heart— who can truly understand it, who is able to hear it?

units.source_en: I stand on the bridge. This mellow, ripened dusk— from afar come the music of flute and zither, dots and threads, round, square, elongated, everywhere pure, blazing gold, pouring down among the ripples, clear blue and evenly still.
units.source_zh:
我站在橋上，

這甜熟的黃昏，

遠處來的簫聲和琴音——點兒，線兒，

圓形，方形，長形，

盡是燦爛的黃金，

傾瀉在波漣裏，

澄藍而凝勻。

で—— あでやかでしなやかなさまに——

units.source_zh:
歌聲，游艇，

燈燭的輝瑩，

夢寐似生，

——絪緼——

幻景似消泯，

在流水的胸前——

鮮妍，綣繾——

流，流，

流入沉沉的黃昏。

units.source_zh:
我靈魂的絃琴，

感受了無形的衝動，

怔忡，惺鬆，

悄悄地吟弄，

一支紅朵蠟的新曲，

出咽的香濃；

但這微妙的心琴喲，

有誰領略，

有誰能聽！
